entries.title: Forget asks right on the secret's row in Settings
entries.body: Forgetting a secret, removing a saved decision, stopping a phone's approvals and deleting Secrets history now ask on the row you clicked, with Keep focused. You stay in Settings instead of being sent to a card on the main screen.

picture.alt: Settings → Secrets with the Website deployment row asking Forget the Website deployment secret?, its two sentences, Keep secret focused and Forget secret
